headline: Bosch Sensortec thesis develops a non-ideal SystemVerilog delta-sigma modulator model
fact: Elias Väänänen’s University of Oulu thesis reports work conducted at Robert Bosch Oy within Bosch Sensortec to improve discrete-time delta-sigma modulator design and mixed-signal verification. It develops SystemVerilog and Simulink behavioral models with nonlinearity and noise, selecting an impulse-invariant approach after comparison with EEnet modeling. The work reports simulation studies, but explicitly leaves transistor-level performance matching, including SNDR, and incremental reset operation untested. It therefore does not establish silicon correlation or sign-off accuracy. The date is the repository’s public-availability date, following its May 15 issue date.

sources.title: Behavioural Modelling of a Discrete-Time Delta-Sigma Modulator Using SystemVerilog and Simulink
sources.summary: Page 6 explicitly locates the work in Robert Bosch Oy’s Bosch Sensortec business unit. Chapters 3–5 describe the HDL modeling and simulation studies; page 67 states that transistor-level performance matching and incremental reset operation were not tested.
